## OSINT4ALL contribution

### What changed?

Describe the resource(s), jurisdiction(s), taxonomy or documentation changed.

### Validation

- [ ] Canonical URLs are HTTPS where available.
- [ ] New AI-assisted entries remain `needs-review`.
- [ ] Any `verified` entry includes `last_verified`.
- [ ] Jurisdictions use GLOBAL / ISO-style tags.
- [ ] Disciplines use the canonical taxonomy.
- [ ] Descriptions distinguish facts from claims/inference.
- [ ] Sensitive resources include appropriate legal/privacy/safety caveats.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/validate_catalog.py`.
- [ ] I ran `python scripts/generate_catalog.py` after data changes.

### Ethical use

- [ ] This change supports lawful, ethical and proportionate open-source research.
